title: Tiny, cute bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff9ecf" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff9ecf" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bowL" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5ca8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff8ec4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bowR" x1="1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5ca8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff8ec4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bowKnot" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffb3d9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff7ab8"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow behind bow tie -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="38" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- left wing of bow -->
  <path d="M 48 50 Q 30 30 16 34 Q 8 38 12 48 Q 14 54 22 56 Q 34 58 48 54 Z"
        fill="url(#bowL)" stroke="#ffb3d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- left wing highlight stripe -->
  <path d="M 44 46 Q 32 38 22 40" fill="none" stroke="#ffd6eb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- right wing of bow -->
  <path d="M 52 50 Q 70 30 84 34 Q 92 38 88 48 Q 86 54 78 56 Q 66 58 52 54 Z"
        fill="url(#bowR)" stroke="#ffb3d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- right wing highlight stripe -->
  <path d="M 56 46 Q 68 38 78 40" fill="none" stroke="#ffd6eb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- center knot -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="7" ry="8" fill="url(#bowKnot)" stroke="#ffd6eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- knot shine -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="47" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#ffe6f2" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#ffd6eb" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#ffd6eb" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffe6f2" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffe6f2" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
